intro: The audit's verdict is PASS-WITH-WARNINGS. Both pass/fail checks pass: every job a city page must do is there, and no claim states a test result or a licence. Full report: https://claude.ai/artifact/UUAKxTv8HEseeXhEHEn6Tz. These fixes change approved content or images, so each needs your yes. Small defects (line spacing, one arrow's contrast, the breadcrumb alignment, a broken check) are being fixed now without asking.

questions.context: The health-tests section asks "Which Health-Test Warning Signs Should Make Me Walk Away From a Seller?" and answers "A seller who names a test but shows you nothing for it". You told us we hold no certificates and should only name the tests, so a careful buyer would walk away from us. Recommended: (a). Why: the advice should point at things a scam seller does and we never do: no video call, no parents, payment before anything is shown, no written contract. Trade-off: the answer no longer pushes buyers to demand test paperwork from any breeder.

options.label: Reword it around what a scam seller won't do (video call, parents, contract, paying first)
Keep it, and I'll get the test certificates so we can show them

questions.question: One of our own answers tells buyers to walk away from us. Reword it?

questions.context: The breed infographic says four things the text doesn't: AmStaff colours, the AKC's 1936 standard date, that the AmStaff is not banned, and that the Pit Bull Terrier is. Search engines and AI answers can't read text inside a picture. Recommended: (a). Why: it's the same facts in a form machines can quote. Trade-off: about 40 more words in the breed section.
questions.question: Put the AmStaff card's facts into the page text, and split two over-long lead sentences?

questions.context: Today there are about 5,000 words between the top button and the enquiry form. Our puppy rules say every puppy card shows the delivery line (£200–£350 delivery or collection in Carlisle). Recommended: (a). Why: buyers who decide halfway down have nowhere to click. Trade-off: two or three more buttons on a long page. I'll preview them first.

options.label: Yes, preview them for my approval

questions.question: Add a call to action in the middle of the page, and the delivery line on each puppy ticket?

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: each one says something untrue, or nonsense, next to our name: - an AI picture of a "Certificate of Health", although we hold none; - a van in BlueStaffyUK livery with phone digits painted on it; - a "DEFRA transport partners" diagram in gibberish text; - a "BlueStaffyUK vs Classified Ads" chart in gibberish text; - a "Myths vs Facts" chart with misspellings. Trade-off: their old files stay on the server (rule 11); the page just stops using them. Replacement photos come to you at an Asset Gate first.

options.label: Yes, swap them for real photos (I'll pick at an Asset Gate)
Yes, and remove them from every other page that uses them too

questions.question: Take five misleading or garbled pictures off the London page, and put real photos in their place?

questions.context: For example, one says "a smiling breeder" where no face is shown, and one calls a fawn puppy blue. One alt also says "rated among the best Staffy breeders UK", which no source supports. Rule 15 allows a migrated alt to change when it states a wrong fact; each change is recorded. Recommended: (a). Why: wrong alts mislead screen-reader users and Google Images. Trade-off: these images lose their old alt wording, which may have ranked.

options.label: Yes, fix all 13 and drop the "among the best" line

questions.question: Fix the 13 alt texts that describe a different picture?

questions.context: The page says so (from the old site's FAQ). Answer yes or no, plus anything to add.

questions.context: Answer yes or no for each.
questions.question: Does every puppy leave with a vet-signed health card, plus first vaccinations, a microchip, worming and flea treatment?

questions.context: Answer yes or no for each.
questions.question: Is every litter raised in your home, never in kennels, and do you support buyers yourself after collection?
